jobs.title: Vacature: Process Mining Engineer - NN Bank Hypotheken - View vacancy
jobs.description:
NN Bank Hypotheken is op een missie om de digitale retailbank van Nederland te worden. Daarbij is het (digitaal) optimaliseren van processen van een hypotheek op basis van data een essentieel onderdeel! Door onze digitale diensten en processen naar een hoger niveau te brengen, maken we het verschil voor onze klanten en onafhankelijke adviseurs. Dat data gedreven werken waarbij we gebruikmaken van process mining tooling is daarbij onze sleutel tot succes.


En jouw rol is daarbij van groot belang! Jij bent degene die ons team naar een hoger niveau brengt in data gedreven werken en het gebruik van process mining en daarmee optimale waarde levert in het optimaliseren van onze processen voor onze klanten, adviseurs en collega’s. Zo zorg je er samen met je team voor dat onze dienstverlening sneller, betrouwbaarder en voorspelbaarder wordt.


We staan aan het begin van een hele mooie en interessante reis en zijn op zoek naar mensen zoals jij die helpen deze verandering te realiseren.


Als NN Bank helpen we mensen zorgen voor wat zij echt belangrijk vinden. Zoals het realiseren van hun woonwensen voor nu en later. Daarvoor werken we aan een klantgerichte, digitale en data gedreven bank. Waarbij we met behulp van technologie het verschil gaan maken.


Onze missie is om onze klanten, intermediairs en medewerkers een optimale ervaring te geven in het hypotheek proces van aanvraag tot aflossing, zodat klanten hun woonwens kunnen realiseren. Belangrijk daarbij is dat je als Process Mining Engineer, ervoor zorgt dat we onze process mining tools optimaal inzetten voor analyses en inzichten zodat verbeteringen en optimalisaties in de hypotheken processen gerealiseerd worden.


Je staat te popelen om nieuwe dingen te leren en je deelt je kennis over data gedreven werken en process mining enthousiast met je collega's. Je bent nieuwsgierig, neemt eigenaarschap en je waardeert feedback, voor jezelf en anderen, omdat je begrijpt dat feedback ons allemaal helpt groeien.


**Wat je gaat doen**

Je bent een enthousiaste en ervaren ontwikkelaar op het gebied van process mining. Als Process Mining Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, implementeren en onderhouden van proces mining inzichten in onze process mining tool Celonis. Je werkt aan het realiseren van dashboards en het analyseren van gegevens om inzichten te verkrijgen en de efficiëntie van bedrijfsprocessen te verbeteren.


Verantwoordelijkheden:


* Integreren van ontvangen data in het data model van onze process mining tool en het onderhouden van dat data model
* Zorgdragen voor en aantonen dat we werken volgens en voldoen aan de IT risico beheersings maatregelen
* Ontwikkelen en implementeren van process mining inzichten binnen de hypotheken keten
* Creëren van dashboards en visualisaties met behulp van onze process mining tool, Celonis, om procesinformatie effectief te ontsluiten naar de collega’s in de teams en naar de business
* Bijdragen aan de continue verbetering van de process mining methodologieën en \-technieken binnen het team
* Samenwerken met collega’s binnen en buiten je team, zoals data engineers, data\-analisten en business analisten, om de beste proces oplossingen te ontwerpen en te implementeren
* Ondersteunen van gebruikers bij het begrijpen en gebruiken van de ontwikkelde process mining inzichten

**Wat wij jou bieden**


NN investeert in een inclusieve, inspirerende werkomgeving en in vaardigheden en competenties voor de toekomst. Daarbij passen arbeidsvoorwaarden die aansluiten bij wat er vandaag nodig is én die rekening houden met de toekomst. Zo bieden we onze medewerkers de mogelijkheid het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Wij bieden jou:


* Salaris tussen € 4\.527 en € 6\.036 op basis van 36 uur en afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring
* 13de maand en vakantiegeld wordt maandelijks uitbetaald bij je salaris
* 27 vakantiedagen bij een werkweek van 5 dagen en drie Diversiteitsdagen
* Een moderne pensioenregeling uitgevoerd door BeFrank
* Volop training\- en opleidingsmogelijkheden
* NS Business Card 2e klas, waarmee je onbeperkt kunt reizen, ook privé. Reis je liever met eigen vervoer? Declareer dan je kilometers
* Thuiswerkvergoedingen voor internet en een goede werkplek

**Wat je meebrengt**


Als Process Mining Engineer heb je passie voor data en het gebruik van data voor het analyseren van (digitale) werkstromen en het vertalen van business wensen en proces optimalisaties naar concrete requirements. Daarbij heb je gedegen ervaring met process mining tooling, het integreren van organisatie databronnen met Celonis en heb je ervaring en drive om processen te optimaliseren en digitaliseren. Optimalisaties en verbeteringen in het proces onderbouw je met concrete getallen en bedragen. Samenwerken is voor jou een vanzelfsprekendheid, waarbij je goed en duidelijk communiceert en verbinding weet te maken met je directe collega’s, gebruikers en andere stakeholders. Daarbij ben je betrokken, heb je een goede dosis daadkracht en neem je eigenaarschap. Verder beschik je over:


* Een afgeronde HBO of Universitaire opleiding
* Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring, waarvan tenminste 2 jaar in een vergelijkbare functie
* Ervaring met process mining tooling en technieken (bij voorkeur Celonis) om daarmee optimalisaties in processen te herkennen en te analyseren en deze te vertalen naar concrete en aantoonbare verbeteringen
* Inzicht in bedrijfsprocessen en het vermogen om complexe gedigitaliseerde processen aan de hand van data en datastromen te analyseren en te begrijpen. Bij voorkeur in het hypotheek proces
* Kennis en ervaring in het werken in een Agile omgeving waar samenwerking en continu verbeteren de basis vormen

**Met wie je werkt**


Je gaat deel uitmaken van een multidisciplinair team met Customer Journey specialisten (product\- en procesmanagers). Het team heeft als missie het optimaliseren van de hypotheek processen bij Nationale\-Nederlanden. Jij en je teamleden nemen verantwoordelijkheid voor de teamresultaten en zijn niet bang om fouten te maken, te delen en ervan te leren. **What do we do?**
------------------


**Introducing Thinkproject Platform**


Thinkproject is a European leader in the digitalization of the construction industry, with
  

offices and customers spanning Europe and beyond.


Founded in 2000 — when construction project planning was still predominantly manual — Thinkproject was built on deep industry expertise and a mission to make complex
  

construction projects manageable. Today, we call it Construction Intelligence: software
  

that makes construction projects more efficient, safer, more punctual, and above
  

all, more sustainable.


**VDC Manager** is one of the flagship products in our portfolio — a complete openBIM
  

platform at the intersection of 3D modeling, process management, and data
  

intelligence.


**What your day will look like**
--------------------------------


**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a C\+\+ Software Developer to join the team behind VDC
  

Manager — Thinkproject's complete openBIM software, developed by industry experts
  

and trusted by AEC professionals worldwide.


VDC Manager enables the merging of diverse data and information into BIM processes,
  

including model checking and clash detection in 3D models, construction schedule
  

creation and 4D simulation, quantity and dimension determination for cost calculations, and much more. As a member of the engineering team, you will take ownership of complex features, drive technical decisions, and help shape the future of one of Europe's leading BIM platforms.


**What You Will Do**
  

**Core Development**


* Architect, design, develop, and test new and existing features within VDC Manager
* Write clean, well\-structured, secure, and testable modern C\+\+ code (C\+\+17/20\)
* Take ownership of complex technical areas — from geometry processing and 3D rendering to data exchange and cloud connectivity
* Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing systems with a focus on performance, scalability, and reliability
* Drive technical analysis and research, including evaluation and selection of technical approaches and third\-party components

**Collaboration \& Communication**


* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX designers, and BIM domain experts to translate requirements into robust technical solutions
* Demonstrate and present technical work to product owners and stakeholders in a clear and structured manner
* Work as part of a distributed, international team — contributing to technical discussions on implementation approaches and user interfaces
* Continuously learn and apply modern tools, frameworks, and engineering processes
**What you need to fulfill the role**
-------------------------------------


**Must\-Have**


* Knowledge of C/C\+\+, including modern standards (C\+\+14/17/20\).
* Hands\-on experience with graphics programming (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, or similar)
* Strong skills in software architecture, data structures, and design patterns
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills — able to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software quality practices (performance, scalability, security, testability)
* Fluency in English (written and spoken) — our working language across the engineering team

**Strong Advantages**


* 2\-3 years of professional software development experience.
* Experience with Qt for desktop application development
* Knowledge of BIM concepts, workflows, and data formats (IFC, BCF) and/or experience in the AEC industry
* Experience with JavaScript (user scripts), Python (utilities and build tooling), or C\# (plug\-in development and web services for Thinkproject cloud connectivity)
* Familiarity with web services and REST APIs for cloud platform integration
* German language skills are a plus but not required

**Code Sample (Required)**
  

As part of your application, please share a C/C\+\+ code sample that best represents your coding style and preferences.


* It does not need to be executable or a complete program
* It can come from a personal project or a previous role (anonymization is perfectly fine)
* You are welcome to supplement it with screenshots, videos, papers, or prototypes — anything that helps showcase your work and engineering thinking
* This is not a test — it is an opportunity to show us how you think and how you write code.
**What we offer**
-----------------


**Hybrid working \| Work from abroad \| Flexible working hours \| Language courses \| Great learning opportunities \| Headspace access \| Women's Network \| Corporate volunteering \| Social events**
  

  

Employee satisfaction is our top priority. Our people make Thinkproject what it is today.
  

We value a work environment where everyone can help shape our culture through open
  

feedback and mutual respect. We believe that flexibility and a diverse benefits program
  

are key success factors — for our employees and for our business.
*We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all*
  

*backgrounds, nationalities, and career paths.*

jobs.title: Graduate Sustainability Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

Cundall’s leading Sustainability \& Building Physics team is a key part of our international business. As a recognised leader in sustainability across the world, our team believes that we have so much more we can and need to do. With a brilliant track record of designing innovative, sustainable and energy efficient solutions, that minimise the use of natural resources, the team are looking for graduates who are passionate about helping us make a positive impact to our environment and a difference to our homes, offices, industry and community.  

Join our Sustainability Team and you can be involved in innovative and award\-winning projects – past projects have included the prized Hong Kong Science Park, Australia’s first 6 star Green Star community, and the largest bio\-medical precinct in the Southern Hemisphere.
The Role You'll Play:

This is an excellent opportunity for talented sustainability graduates to join our teams to work on some of the most exciting sustainable design projects in UK and around the world.

  

Working under the guidance and supervision of the experienced team, you’ll develop your existing knowledge and skills in energy modelling and assist with the development of energy and sustainability strategies for new build and existing buildings. You will find yourself working on projects that fall within the following workstreams:

* Building physics and parametric model services
* Building performance and operational energy optimisation
* Certification and compliance
* Health and wellbeing advice and guidance
* Net zero and whole life carbon services
* Sustainability design and ESG services


With the opportunity to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop over time, you’ll be supported and encouraged to work towards Chartership through one of our accredited training schemes.


The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level in Sustainable Engineering or the Built Environment (or equivalent).
* You have demonstrable knowledge and experience of building physics, particularly in relation to heat transfer, energy, thermal comfort and natural ventilation.
* A working knowledge of climate\-based daylighting analysis, operational energy calculation using TM54, sustainability rating tools such as BREEAM and life cycle carbon costing would also be really beneficial.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

**What’s in it for you?**

  

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.  

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

* A one\-off joining bonus of £1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A £2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.


Graduate Brochure
Job Description *Must have right to work in the UK, we do not provide sponsorship for this role.* **We know that to be the best at what we do we need a diverse workforce underpinned by an inclusive culture. Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.

  

Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day\-to\-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.  

The Structural engineering teams provide industry\-leading expertise – and offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state\-of\-the\-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon \- new music school.
The Role You'll Play:

In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in the UK and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.  

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem\-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.  

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.  

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering.
* You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially \- have a passion for creative and intuitive design.
* Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.

**Engineering \& Quantity Surveying Graduate Development Programme 2027**
=========================================================================


Are you ready to apply your engineering or quantity surveying skills to one of the most ambitious and impactful infrastructure transformations in Ireland?


Do you have, or are you about to get, a degree in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/ Structural, Mechanical / Energy Engineering or as a Quantity Surveyor?


If so, the ESB Technical Graduate Programme is your opportunity to work at the forefront of Ireland’s clean energy transition, designing, building, and maintaining the electricity network that connects homes, businesses, and communities across the country.


With over 1000 engineers, quantity surveyors and related technical professionals, ESB is dedicated to investing in engineering related expertise and developing critical skills to support Ireland’s future growth and development.


ESB’s Technical Graduate Programme is designed for STEM graduates with less than two years’ experience, offering structured development, real responsibility, and the opportunity to contribute to our Net Zero by 2040 strategy. At ESB, we believe our people are the driving force behind everything we do \- today and into the future. That’s why investing in your growth, development and potential isn’t just part of our strategy, it’s at the very heart of it.

  

**The programme has a wide variety of opportunities:**

  

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, quantity surveyors and technical professionals on projects that matter.

  

**What You’ll Work On:**

  

* Delivering energy infrastructure projects for Ireland, with opportunities to be involved at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Designing, planning and building the electricity network of the future
* Helping to shape ESB's generation fleet on site, ensuring the safety, reliability and resilience of our thermal and renewable energy facilities
* Supporting Ireland's largest private telecoms network, helping keep ESB's infrastructure connected and operating safely
* Supporting ESB’s customers to optimise their energy use \& develop sustainable energy solutions
  

**Our bespoke Early Career Technical Talent Programme includes:**

  

* Structured, timely learning and development through formal as well as on\-the\-job opportunities
* Work assignments giving appropriate breath of learning to facilitate career progression
* Performance targets set to challenge \& develop you while you contribute to ESB’s strategy
* Mentoring \& career support to enable you to find the right career in the company
* Social networking to develop peer supports \& relationships across ESB
  

In addition:

  

As an employee on our Technical Graduate Programme, you will enjoy our many benefits including a competitive salary and bonus, performance related promotions and a comprehensive benefits package built on the four pillars of reward, career, community, and wellbeing.

  

**Location**

  

Nationwide

  

**What We Look For:**

  

* A Masters, Honours or Ordinary degree (or near completion in 2027\) in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/Structural, Mechanical/Energy Engineering or Quantity Surveying, with aminimum Second Class Honours Grade 1 (2\.1\) result
* Excellent analytical skills combined with the ability to learn quickly
* Proven ability to deliver results in a fast\-paced team environment

Danışmanlığını yapmakta olduğumuz kurumsal iş ortağımız için, yüksek trafikli ve ölçeklenebilir uygulamaların geliştirilmesinde görev alacak, en az 5 yıl deneyimli Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET & Vue.js)
arayışımız bulunmaktadır.

Görev Tanımı:

.NET Core ve Vue.js teknolojileri kullanarak yeni uygulamaların geliştirilmesi ve mevcut uygulamaların iyileştirilmesi,
Ölçeklenebilir, yüksek performanslı ve sürdürülebilir yazılım çözümleri geliştirilmesi,
RESTful API ve GraphQL servislerinin geliştirilmesi ve entegrasyon süreçlerinde görev alınması,
Veritabanı tasarımı, geliştirme ve performans iyileştirme çalışmalarına katkı sağlanması,
Responsive ve kullanıcı deneyimi odaklı web arayüzlerinin geliştirilmesi,
CI/CD süreçleri ve modern yazılım geliştirme standartlarına uygun geliştirme yapılması,
Kod kalitesi, güvenlik ve performans standartlarının gözetilerek yazılım geliştirilmesi,
Yapay zekâ destekli geliştirme araçlarından faydalanarak geliştirme süreçlerinin verimliliğinin artırılması,
Agile ekiplerle iş birliği içerisinde yazılım geliştirme yaşam döngüsünün tüm aşamalarında aktif rol alınması.
